decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with powerful "enter the battlefield" abilities to pressure the opponent and control the board. By repeatedly flickering these creatures with cards like Ephemerate and Persist, the deck can generate value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the inclusion of equipment like Batterskull and Sword of Fire and Ice provide additional threats and ways to close out the game. The Orzhov color combination allows for a mix of aggression and disruption, making it versatile in matchups against different archetypes.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, supported by instant removal spells like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt. The deck also includes strong counterspells like Archmage's Charm and Counterspell to control the board. Card draw and selection is provided by spells like Serum Visions and Expressive Iteration, ensuring consistency in drawing threats and answers. The land base consists of fetch lands and utility lands like Fiery Islet to support the deck's aggressive game plan.

This Grixis Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage. It utilizes a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push, Lightning Bolt, and Unholy Heat to deal with threats, while also packing counterspells such as Spell Pierce, Archmage's Charm, and Counterspell to counter key spells. The deck also leverages card selection and card draw with cards like Jace, the Mind Sculptor, Expressive Iteration, and Thought Scour. The win condition is a combination of tempo and pressure, with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent putting pressure on the opponent's life total. The deck's mana base consists of fetch lands and shock lands to ensure consistent access to all three colors.

The core idea of this deck is to quickly fill your graveyard with powerful creatures by cycling them for value, disrupting your opponent's strategy with discard spells, and then casting Living End to bring all your creatures back into play, overwhelming your opponent with a massive board presence. By carefully managing your resources and timing your plays, you can execute your combo efficiently and take control of the game. With the right sequencing and strategy, this deck can catch your opponent off guard and lead you to victory in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Ox of Agonas, then bringing them back onto the battlefield using reanimation spells like Persist and Grief. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with big, impactful creatures early in the game. It also includes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to loop key spells and secure the win. The deck has a mix of removal spells and efficient creatures to control the board while setting up the combo.

The main concept of this Dredge combo deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with cards like Stinkweed Imp and Golgari Thug, triggering abilities like the recursive nature of Prized Amalgam and Silversmote Ghoul. This allows for explosive plays to be made, utilizing creatures like Narcomoeba and Ox of Agonas to maintain pressure on the opponent. Other spells like Cathartic Reunion and Thrilling Discovery help to dig deeper into the deck and fuel the graveyard for even more combos. This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a relentless stream of threats.

The main strategy of this deck is to use mill cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Archive Trap to quickly deplete the opponent's library. Fractured Sanity and Tasha's Hideous Laughter also help with this strategy. The deck also includes control elements like Drown in the Loch and Fatal Push to deal with threats. Visions of Beyond provides card draw, while Surgical Extraction disrupts the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Ensnaring Bridge and Nihil Spellbomb helps protect against creature-based strategies and graveyard shenanigans. The mana base is optimized for quick access to all necessary colors.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Death's Shadow mechanic to quickly establish a powerful board presence and apply pressure to the opponent. By manipulating their own life total through cards like Street Wraith and Mishra's Bauble, the player can quickly bring out large Death's Shadow creatures while using disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek to disrupt their opponent's strategy. With efficient removal spells like Drown in the Loch and Unholy Heat, this deck aims to control the board and win through aggressive, proactive plays.

This deck focuses on creating a fast-paced aggressive strategy by cascading into powerful threats like Crashing Footfalls and Bonecrusher Giant. By using cards with Cascade, the deck can continuously put pressure on the opponent while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Force of Negation. The versatility of cards like Prismari Command and Brazen Borrower provide additional flexibility in handling different situations. The land base is designed to support the fast and consistent mana requirements of the deck while also including utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures for additional resilience.

The deck focuses on using creatures with powerful enter-the-battlefield abilities and sacrificing mechanics to search for key pieces and control the board. Grist, the Hunger Tide serves as the engine of the deck, providing token generation and removal. The toolbox aspect of the deck allows for flexibility in finding the right creature for any situation. The mana base is set up to support the diverse color requirements of the deck, with lands like Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth and Boseiju, Who Endures offering additional utility. The deck aims to generate value and disrupt the opponent's game plan through efficient creature interactions.

This deck focuses on assembling the "Colossus Hammer" combo to quickly deal lethal damage to your opponent. By utilizing cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Puresteel Paladin to find and equip the hammer, along with support cards like Esper Sentinel and Giver of Runes for protection, the deck aims to create a powerful threat that can end the game in just a few turns. The inclusion of cards like Inkmoth Nexus and Shadowspear adds additional versatility and options for winning the game, making it a strong and aggressive combo deck in the Modern format.

The key idea of this deck is to play aggressively, using a combination of efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, along with disruption and control spells like Counterspell and Lightning Bolt. The deck aims to apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with counterspells and removal spells. Jace, the Mind Sculptor provides card advantage and powerful tools for controlling the game. The deck's mana base is optimized for casting both red and blue spells efficiently, allowing for a fast and disruptive playstyle.

The deck focuses on quickly dealing damage to the opponent through low-cost, high-impact spells and aggressive creatures. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient burn spells like Lava Spike, Rift Bolt, and Lightning Bolt, while also utilizing creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear to deal quick damage. Eidolon of the Great Revel punishes opponents for casting spells, adding to the deck's aggressiveness. The inclusion of Boros Charm and Lightning Helix provide versatile options for both damage and protection. The mana base helps ensure quick access to the necessary colors for spells.

The key concept of this deck is to aggressively cascade into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Violent Outburst using cards like Shardless Agent and Brazen Borrower. By combining the cascade mechanic with efficient removal spells like Fury and Force of Negation, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly with token creatures and surprise disruption. The inclusion of versatile cards like Prismari Command and Seasoned Pyromancer also adds flexibility to the deck's game plan, allowing for adaptability in different matchups. The deck's focus on cascading into high-impact spells quickly sets it apart as a fast and potent aggro deck.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and card advantage to control the game, using Urza, Lord High Artificer as a powerful win condition. The deck includes cards like Stoneforge Mystic to search for key equipment pieces, Thopter Foundry and Sword of the Meek for a combo win, and control elements like Teferi, Time Raveler and Metallic Rebuke to disrupt the opponent's plans. The addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value from blinking permanents. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents through efficient use of artifacts and control elements.

This deck aims to ramp up quickly by utilizing land-based acceleration cards like Arboreal Grazer, Azusa, Lost but Seeking, and Explore to get ahead on mana. The key combo involves using Amulet of Vigor to untap lands multiple times in a turn and generate a ton of mana to cast Primeval Titan and search for game-winning lands like Vesuva and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. The deck also includes utility lands like Bojuka Bog and Relic of Progenitus to disrupt opponents. Overall, the strategy revolves around assembling the Amulet Titan combo to overwhelm opponents with powerful land and creature threats.
